title: Minimal
description: Pure black, four large cards with no dock band, soft shadows and a quiet header without the greeting.

evidence.summary: Toolkit preview and screenshots command (No-root, Home 1.6.0 runtime from release v1.5.2): Home with dock and grid focus, header shortcut focus and the Inputs menu; standard Settings isolation captured. Physical remote behavior is not covered by the browser check. 1.0.1: app library rows keep white names and a dark focus, checked in the preview.

LG 60UN7310PDA, webOS 5.6.2, firmware 04.64.00, Magic Remote, No-root, Home 1.6.0 + Helper 0.6.20. Sent with Receive from computer and applied. Home rendered as in the preview and the owner uses it daily. App library, Inputs, reorder, standby and cold boot not checked on the device. The first receiver attempt showed Theme receiver unavailable; Retry worked.
